policy.scope: Scratch upstream build and localization dependency graph
policy.runtimeRule: These are not permission to ship a newly introduced finding. Any Scratch upgrade must regenerate audit and reachability evidence.
policy.evidenceRule: The Scratch standalone bundle is the only runtime entry; build-only and localization tools are not loaded by the packaged renderer. The report is regenerated from the exact lockfile and build output.

exceptions.mitigation: Pin the reviewed Scratch GUI build and upgrade the upstream toolchain before the review date.
